description.value:
Requirements You have an active spell affecting an area or a single ally within 60 feet.

The battlefield isn't always as predictable as you'd like, so you've devised a method to shift around your spell effects after they've been deployed. If the required spell affects an area, you move the spell's area to a new location, and the spell no longer affects its previous area. If the required spell affects a single ally, you move the spell to a new ally, and the spell no longer affects its previous target. The new area or target must meet any of the spell's usual requirements, including range and line of effect from you when you Recalculate Coordinates. Regardless of the required spell's area or target, the spell's remaining duration is reduced by half.
